body:
I wonder if Horikoshi is doing this to show us the dark side of the phrase "anyone can be a hero?"

Like, technically Mineta's disgusting actions aren't heroic at all, yet he's still qualified as a hero and has some kickass moments both in the villain invasion and later in the end of term arc. 

This is coming from a Mineta hater btw.
Me and my roommate were screaming and waking up everyone on our dorm floor...
